Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Kingdom Of Rock" was released in 2007 based on the instruction to "select the earliest release year found for any album with that exact title" and a preliminary mention of a 2007 listing. This was a hallucination and a logical error because the search results visible in Step 2 (and confirmed in later steps) did not show a 2007 album titled "Kingdom Of Rock"; the 2007 results were lists of albums or unrelated entries. The Planner failed to verify the existence of the 2007 album before making the definitive claim that it predates "Was I The Wave?" (2011), leading the subsequent search strategy to focus incorrectly on verifying a non-existent 2007 release rather than confirming the known 2008 release by Graham Elks or other valid entries.
